page_title: EIN 1-0 AUG | Eintracht Frankfurt v Augsburg 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Frank Willenborg is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Mert Komur (Augsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+6' The free kick from long range, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' The main referee, Frank Willenborg, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+4' Augsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+3' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+2' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Frank Willenborg interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+2' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Celebrations are cut short for Augsburg as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
89' Wait! Referee Frank Willenborg has indicated he is going to review the Augsburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
86' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) perfectly latches on to a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
86' The ball goes out for a corner. Augsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg) latches on to an accurate cross inside the box and quickly shoots, but unluckily for him one of his own teammates gets in the way of the ball and blocks the shot.
83' Substitution. Dimitrios Giannoulis is replaced by Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).
83' Manuel Baum has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Wolf (Augsburg) replacing Robin Fellhauer.
81' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Ansgar Knauff cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Samuel Essende (Augsburg) coming on for Fabian Rieder.
76' Manuel Baum prepares a substitution. Han-Noah Massengo is replaced by Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg).
75' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
72' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
71' The attendance is 55000.

70' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen made a superb athletic save to deny him.

68' 1 - 0 GOAL 1:0! Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
66' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Mert Komur (Augsburg) replaces Alexis Claude-Maurice.
66' The free kick from long range, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

65' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
64' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Augsburg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
62' Here's the change. Mahmoud Dahoud leaves the pitch and Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
62' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Robin Koch is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' Looks like Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

57' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
56' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
55' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) sends a long ball in, but Michael Zetterer comfortably gathers the ball.
55' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
53' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
51' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle and signals a foul after Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) brought his opponent down.
51' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
48' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
47' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
46' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Can Yilmaz Uzun comes on the pitch for Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The game is over for Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt). Nathaniel Brown comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

45+3' What a great effort! Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
44' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Frank Willenborg and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
38' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is caught offside!
37' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
35' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
34' Augsburg fail to score from a corner as Michael Zetterer (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaps to collect the ball.
33' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
29' Augsburg take a short corner kick.
29' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Anton Kade (Augsburg) heads on.
21' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
19' Anton Kade (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Anton Kade (Augsburg) is adjudged offside.
14' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
13' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.
10' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' The Augsburg players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
4' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Augsburg goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.

3' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) gets to the ball inside the penalty area and produces a bullet header towards the goal. He aims his effort nicely inside the right post, leaving Michael Zetterer helpless. He makes it 0:1.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Frank Willenborg.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
